name.description: Component name (e.g. 'avatar-upload'). Becomes the file name (kebab) and class name (PascalCase + 'Component').

operationId.description: Stable upload operation ID from the packed application contract.

fieldName.description: Typed body property receiving the selected File.

contractPackage.description: Browser-safe package exporting the application contract type.

contractType.description: Application contract type exported by contractPackage.

bindingPackage.description: Browser-safe generated package exporting the upload binding.

apiImport.description: Import path to the generated application API boundary.

path.description: Directory to scaffold under. Default: src/app/components.
